name: Zero no Mono
source:
This is a voiced game that colors and animates 5 doujin manga:

1. 18-page doujin from Comic "Zenshin Nenmaku Shoujo" by Zero no Mono
2. 16-page doujin from Comic "Iku Made Okashite Miru?" by Zero no Mono
3. 24-page doujin from Comic "Yaritai Kibun" by Zero no Mono
4. 16-page doujin from Comic "Zenshin Nenmaku Shoujo" by Zero no Mono
5. 16-page doujin "Rarirurero (ラリるれろ)" by Zero no Mono (from Comic Bijin Sensee Chitsunai Shasei 08-2002)
